class.name: DrawingServer
class.brief_description: Pictures drawn on the GPU, by RID, and the fonts and images they are drawn with.
class.description: A drawing is a picture a script or a node draws - a cab's screen, a station's board - made of shapes, text and pasted images. Each drawing is drawn on the GPU into a texture; after a change it is drawn again once, in the next frame, so nothing runs while nothing changes and nothing is copied through the CPU. Its texture ([method drawing_get_texture]) is shown by a [DrawingTexture]. Coordinates are pixels, the y axis pointing down. A line, an outline and a pixel are drawn through the middle of the pixels their points name; a rectangle and a text start at their top left corner. Colours with an alpha below 1 are mixed with what is drawn under them. The owner of a drawing may pass its picture through a material of its own ([method drawing_set_material]) - a [code]canvas_item[/code] shader that gives the picture a look of its kind at another size. The server itself brings no such look. Fonts and images are read from files the caller names; a script reads them through [code]reloaded.draw[/code], from its data directory ([method ScenarioScriptServer.context_set_data_dir]).

method.name: drawing_add_ellipse
method.description: Fills the ellipse [param rect] bounds.

method.name: drawing_add_ellipse_outline
method.description: Draws the edge of the ellipse [param rect] bounds, [param width] [lb]px[rb] wide, inside it.

method.name: drawing_add_line
method.description: Draws a line through [param points], [param width] [lb]px[rb] wide.

method.name: drawing_add_pieslice
method.description: Fills the slice of the ellipse [param rect] bounds from [param start] to [param end] [lb]deg[rb], measured clockwise from three o'clock.

method.name: drawing_add_pixel
method.description: Sets the pixel at [param position] to [param color].

method.name: drawing_add_polygon
method.description: Fills the polygon of [param points].

method.name: drawing_add_polygon_outline
method.description: Draws the closed edge of the polygon of [param points], [param width] [lb]px[rb] wide.

method.name: drawing_add_rect
method.description: Fills [param rect] with [param color].

method.name: drawing_add_rect_outline
method.description: Draws the edge of [param rect], [param width] [lb]px[rb] wide, inside the rectangle.

method.name: drawing_add_text
method.description: Draws [param text] in [param font] of [param size] [lb]px[rb], its top left corner at [param position].

method.name: drawing_add_texture
method.description: Pastes the part [param source_rect] of an image or of another drawing [param source] into [param rect], scaled to it, tinted with [param modulate] and mixed by its alpha. A negative size of [param rect] flips it where it stands. [param filter] says how it is sampled when scaled.

method.name: drawing_add_texture_rotated
method.description: Pastes an image or another drawing [param source] turned by [param angle] [lb]deg[rb] counter-clockwise about its middle, its middle at [param center].

method.name: drawing_clear
method.description: Everything drawn on [param drawing] goes and it is filled with [param color], opaque in an opaque drawing.

method.name: drawing_create
method.description: Makes a drawing of [param size] [lb]px[rb]: transparent when [param transparent], opaque black otherwise. An opaque drawing stays opaque whatever is drawn on it.

method.name: drawing_get_size
method.description: The size of [param drawing] [lb]px[rb].

method.name: drawing_get_texture
method.description: The RenderingServer texture [param drawing] ends in: its picture, or the picture through its material. It keeps its RID until [method drawing_set_material] is called. Empty in a run without a renderer.

method.name: drawing_set_flip_y
method.description: The drawing's texture holds the picture upside down: its first row is the picture's bottom, as models whose texture coordinates count up from the bottom (OpenGL's) take a texture. The drawing is drawn as ever, from its top; with a material ([method drawing_set_material]) the picture passes through it the right way up and the result is turned over.

method.name: drawing_set_material
method.description: Passes the picture of [param drawing] through [param material], a [code]canvas_item[/code] shader, into a texture of [param output_size] [lb]px[rb]. An invalid [param material] takes the pass away. [method drawing_get_texture] returns another RID after it, so a [DrawingTexture] showing the drawing is attached again.

method.name: font_get_text_size
method.description: The width and height [lb]px[rb] [param text] takes in [param font] of [param size].

method.name: font_load
method.description: Reads a TrueType or OpenType font from [param path], its edges smoothed as [param antialiasing] says: [constant TextServer.FONT_ANTIALIASING_NONE] draws its glyphs in whole pixels, as a LED board shows them. Returns an empty RID when it cannot be read.

method.name: free_rid
method.description: Frees a drawing, a font or an image.

method.name: image_get_pixel
method.description: The colour of the pixel of [param image] at [param position].

method.name: image_get_size
method.description: The size of [param image] [lb]px[rb].

method.name: image_load
method.description: Reads an image from [param path] (png, bmp, tga, dds and the other formats [Image] reads). Returns an empty RID when it cannot be read.

method.name: image_load_mask
method.description: Reads an image from [param path] as a mask: white, as opaque as the image's alpha, or as its brightness when it has no alpha. Pasted with a tint ([method drawing_add_texture]), it is drawn in the tint's colour.

method.name: owns
method.description: Whether [param rid] is a drawing, a font or an image of the server.

constants.constant: Each pixel of the source taken as it is.
Smoothed, with mipmaps when it is made smaller.
